title: VERIDIAN OpenAPI info-block required-metadata fields
description: Phase 2 (task-20260724-115044) metadata-domain design artifact. Validates the `info` object of any ai-os/openapi/*.openapi.yaml document this same phase's api-contract domain authors -- the one concrete 'OpenAPI info objects once authored' target AUDITOR_ENGINE_PHASE_PLAN_2026-07-24.yaml's metadata domain row names explicitly. Stricter than Spectral's own built-in info-contact/info-description warnings (which only check presence) -- this also requires a real license and a non-placeholder description length, since a 1-character description would satisfy Spectral's own rule but not actually document anything.

description.description: 40-char floor is a VERIDIAN-specific quality bar beyond Spectral's own info-description rule (presence-only) -- a real contract description must say more than a placeholder sentence.
